title: Early impressions and hopes
summary: This topic combines early-ownership caveats, hopes for future developments, and isolated comments about enjoyable driving or dissatisfaction, so the sample is not a single coherent aspect.

positive.summary: The positive review praises the car as enjoyable for early-morning drives on twisty roads and roundabouts.

negative.summary: The negative reviews express concern that a bad experience may not be a one-off and criticize an idea the reviewer does not want to continue.

undetermined.summary: The undetermined reviews mostly contain non-evaluative phrases about it being early days or hopes that feedback is useful, with one aspirational comment about a future small electric car and one unclear positive-leaning loyalty remark.

limitations: The cluster mixes unrelated subjects, including driving enjoyment, early judgments, feedback sign-offs, dealer loyalty, and wishes for a future electric car.
Most examples are undetermined, which limits clear interpretation of a consistent customer opinion.
Some fragments are too brief or context-free to identify the specific vehicle attribute being discussed.
